# 🎬 PLOT — Movie & Series Tracker

> Never lose track of what you're watching again.

PLOT is an Android app that helps you manage your personal watchlist for movies and TV series. Add titles, track your progress, and keep your entertainment life organized — all in one place.

---

## 📱 Features

- 📋 **Add & manage** movies and series to your personal watchlist
- ✅ **Track status** — Want to Watch, Watching, Completed
- ✏️ **Update & edit** entries anytime
- 🗑️ **Remove titles** you're done with
- 🎨 Clean and simple user interface

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |
| Logic | JavaScript (71%) |
| Backend / Scripts | Python |
| Platform | Android (APK) |
| Build Tool | Vibe Coding |

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Option 1 — Download APK (Recommended)
1. Go to the [Releases](../../releases) section
2. Download the latest `.apk` file
3. Enable **Install from Unknown Sources** on your Android device
4. Install and launch PLOT

### Option 2 — Run from Source
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/DharmavarapuVishnuRuthvik1912/PLOT-app.git

# Navigate into the project
cd PLOT-app
```
